label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Rose from 329 to 331 in UNGRD's Aug 25 18:30 balance, the first change in the toll since Aug 22.

label: Injured
contestNote: UNGRD's Aug 25 18:30 balance revised injured down to 4,449 from 4,592 (Aug 23); a same-day Cali-specific report separately counted 149 patients still under active medical care in that city alone.

label: Missing
contestNote: Ticked back up from 234 (Aug 23 balance) to 240 in UNGRD's Aug 25 18:30 balance, reversing the prior week's narrowing trend as identification work continues.

label: Structures Destroyed
contestNote: Grew from 31,519 (Aug 23) to 33,275 destroyed / 185,889 damaged-but-standing homes in UNGRD's Aug 25 balance, plus 655 buildings collapsed and 6,310 damaged, across 494 municipios.

label: Departments Affected
contestNote: Holding at 16 departments / 494 municipios in UNGRD's Aug 25 18:30 balance, unchanged from Aug 23; which department was added beyond Decree 1261's original 15 remains unclarified.

label: Reconstruction Cost Estimate
contestNote: Estimates range from Oxford Economics' $1–2B to USGS's ~$40B (7% of GDP) — a 20x spread. Housing Minister Jaime Andrés Beltrán said Aug 26 the quake has 'significantly altered' national budget projections, requiring financing beyond the general budget.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
contestNote: New shallow aftershocks continue near the epicentral zone — seven near Sipí/Andagoya on Aug 24, then a fresh cluster (M2.1–3.3) centered on Istmina and the San Juan municipalities overnight Aug 25–26 — though SGC has not published an updated running total since 325+ (Aug 17).
